The '''golden age of the Celestials''' was a [[Time/Legends|time]] period during which the [[Celestial/Legends|Celestials]] [[Species/Legends|species]] ruled [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The ancient creature known as the [[Mnggal-Mnggal]] claimed to have witnessed the golden age of the Celestials before their sudden withdrawal from the galaxy by [[30,000 BBY]].<ref name="TUR" />
